units.source_text: 明日即将入山，今日与往常不同，八亲王向山庄各处巡行察看。

en.t: Since he was to enter the mountains the next day, Prince Hachi spent this day differently from usual, going around the villa and inspecting every part of it.

units.source_text: 这本来是一所简陋的住宅，他暂在这里草草度日而已。

en.t: It was originally a simple and shabby dwelling, and he had only been passing his days there for the time being.

units.source_text: 但念自身死后，两个青年女子怎么能够耐性地笼闭在这里度日呢？

en.t: But when he thought of his own death, how could the two young women endure spending their days shut away in such a place?

units.source_text: 他一面流泪，一面念经，姿态实甚清秀动人。

en.t: He recited sutras through his tears, and his bearing was truly pure, graceful, and moving.

units.source_text: 他召唤几个年龄较长的侍女来前，嘱咐道：“你们要好好服侍两位小姐，好教我放心。

en.t: He called several of the older serving women before him and instructed them, saying, “Serve the two young ladies well, so that I may be at ease.

units.source_text: 大凡出身本来微贱、在世默默无闻的人，子孙衰微是常有的事，世人也不加以注目。

en.t: For people of low birth who have lived unnoticed in the world, it is common for their descendants to decline, and society pays no particular attention.

units.source_text: 但像我们这等身份的人家，别人如何看法虽然不得而知，但倘过分衰败，实在对不起祖宗，困苦之事也一定很多。

en.t: But for a family of our rank, though I cannot know how others may judge us, too great a decline would truly dishonor our ancestors and would surely bring many hardships.

units.source_text: 岑寂度送岁月，原是寻常之事，不足为异。

en.t: To pass the years in loneliness and quiet is, after all, an ordinary thing and nothing strange.

units.source_text: 但能恪守家规，不坠家声，则外间名声可保，自己也无愧于心。

en.t: But if you faithfully keep the family rules and do not let the family name fall, your reputation outside can be preserved, and you will have nothing to be ashamed of in your own hearts.

units.source_text: 世间常有希图荣华富贵而终于不得如意称心之事。

en.t: In this world, people often seek glory, wealth, and rank, only to find in the end that things do not go as they wished.

units.source_text: 故切不可轻率从事，让两位小姐委身与不良之人。”

en.t: Therefore you must never act rashly and allow the two young ladies to give themselves to unworthy men.”

units.source_text: 他准备在天色未明之时入山，临行又走进女公子室中，对她们说：“我死之后，你们切勿悲伤。

en.t: He intended to enter the mountains before dawn, and just before leaving he went once more into the young ladies’ room and said to them, “After I die, you must not grieve.

units.source_text: 应该心境开朗，常常玩玩琴筝。

en.t: You should keep your hearts cheerful and often amuse yourselves by playing the kin and the koto.

units.source_text: 须知世间万事都不能如意称心，故切不可执迷不悟。”

en.t: You must understand that nothing in this world can go entirely as one wishes, and so you must never cling blindly to sorrow.”

units.source_text: 说罢出门而去，犹自屡屡回头。

en.t: After saying this, he went out the door, still turning back again and again.

units.source_text: 八亲王入山后，两位女公子更觉寂寞无聊，她们晨夕共话，相依为命，说道：“如果我们两人之中少了一人，另一人如何过日子呢？

en.t: After Prince Hachi entered the mountains, the two young ladies felt even lonelier and more desolate; morning and evening they talked together, depended on each other for life itself, and said, “If one of us two were gone, how would the other go on living?

units.source_text: 人世之事，不论目前或未来，都是变幻无定的。

en.t: The affairs of this human world, whether present or future, are all changeable and uncertain.

units.source_text: 万一分别了，如何是好！”

en.t: If we should ever be separated, what would we do?”

units.source_text: 她们有时哀泣，有时欢笑。

en.t: Sometimes they wept in sorrow, and sometimes they laughed together.

units.source_text: 不论游戏玩耍或正当事务，都同心协力，互相慰勉，如此日复一日。

en.t: Whether in play or in proper duties, they joined their hearts and efforts, comforting and encouraging each other as the days went by.
